slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within the month. It only asked about capacity timing and purchase/sales limits, then assumed a monthly inventory balance without confirming intra-month purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, or at least that monthly purchase timing does not affect the inventory capacity constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within the month, but its READY_TO_MODEL inventory dynamics and capacity constraint treat purchases as part of a monthly balance without confirming whether purchases happen at the start or end of the month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including capacity timing, purchase/sales limits, objective meaning, and terminal inventory value, but it failed to ask about the timing of purchases within each month and silently assumed a monthly inventory balance. This leaves a P1 hidden slot unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
